'''Malvin''' was an [[under-lieutenant]] of the [[Tower Guard]] during the [[Aiel War]].

==Appearance==
He is a sour-faced young man.

==History==
Malvin greets [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]] as they return to the stables after searching for the child who may be the Dragon Reborn. He is angry because he did not get to go fight the Aiel. {{ref/book|0|5}}
